title: G'Day 30A
meta_description: Welcome to G'Day 30A, your laid-back coastal retreat in Inlet Beach. Enjoy 3 bedrooms, an outdoor lounge, grill, resort-style community pool, and a scenic trail to Lake Powell.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Welcome to G'Day 30A---a relaxed and stylish retreat tucked into the laid-back charm of Inlet Beach. Inside, you'll find a bright and open living space with a breezy beach vibe, shiplap walls, and comfortable furnishings that invite you to kick back and stay awhile. The fully equipped kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a spacious island, and all the essentials for whipping up everything from pancake breakfasts to sunset charcuterie boards. Sleeping arrangements include a serene king suite with a private ensuite bathroom featuring a double vanity and sleek walk-in shower. A cozy queen room and a bunk room with a twin-over-queen setup round out the sleeping quarters, all designed with comfort and rest in mind. A shared hall bath with a tub/shower combo makes it easy to rinse off the day's fun. Step outside and you'll discover one of G'Day 30A's best-kept secrets: a charming outdoor lounge deck surrounded by 30A's stunning Camp Helen State Park accompanied by lush greenery---perfect for sipping morning coffee, firing up the propane grill, or winding down with a glass of wine or an IPA under the stars. Behind the home, a scenic walking trail leads you straight to the tranquil shores of Lake Powell, offering easy access to paddleboarding, kayaking, and unforgettable waterfront views. For beach days, it's only a 3-minute drive from the door to the sand for easy drop-offs at South Walton Lake Shore Dr---especially helpful for family or friends who may have difficulty walking or carrying heavy gear to the beach.

ABOUT THE AREA: This home is an oasis within Inlet Beach. It offers the tranquility you need to rejuvenate from your busy life yet experience as many activities as you desire along our stunning Emerald Coast. This incredible home is in a beautiful coastal community with a saltwater pool and dock right on Lake Powell that enables you to launch your paddle board, kayak, canoe or fishing pole. The public beach is under a mile away with Inlet Beach boasting the largest public beach access on 30A.
BEACH ACCESS: There are four public beaches just a short distance away. Right across Highway 98 is Inlet Beach Access.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King bed, Ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- Queen bed
• Bedroom 3 -- Twin over Queen bunk bed

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Community Pool (unheated)
• Primary bedroom with private ensuite bathroom
• Covered front porch and covered balcony
• Outdoor propane grill
• Washer/Dryer
• Tesla charger
• Fully stocked kitchen with a Keurig
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, washcloths, etc.
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods, trash bags, kitchen towels, bar of soap for shower

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- This home comes with a pack n' play travel crib.
- There is a tesla charger available for guest use.

Parking Details:
- 2 parking spaces available.
- Street parking is not allowed. Vehicles parked on the street may be towed.
- There is a tesla charger available for guest use.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

STR Permit Registration: STR2024-221872
